title: Change Pilot Input
description: Input contract for the change-pilot skill. raw_text is required; context is optional disambiguation only and must never be used to invent functionality or benefit.

raw_text.description: R&D raw change-point description, possibly containing technical implementation details, file names, IDs, version numbers, etc.

context.description: Optional disambiguation context. Used only to help interpret raw_text. Never used to invent new functionality, performance, or benefit.

module.description: Module or feature area, e.g. 扫码

mode.description: default returns customer_output only; debug also returns the analysis block.
